name: Huge Gnoll Claw
summary: In southwestern Elwynn, Hogger's death is proven by his huge claw. Stormwind's authorities in Goldshire require it before paying the bounty.

sections.title: Bounty Hunter's Proof
sections.body: For months, Hogger has terrorized the southern woodlands of Forest's Edge. Patrols have failed to stop him, and the local garrison cannot corral or subdue the brute. The Stormwind Army is stretched thin across Elwynn, so it has posted an open bounty on his head. Marshal Dughan in Goldshire requires clear proof before paying. Hogger's oversized claw leaves no doubt that the notorious marauder has fallen.

faq.q: What is the Huge Gnoll Claw used for?
aliases: what do i do with hogger claw
faq.answer: Bring Hogger's claw to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire as proof of his death, and collect the posted bounty.

faq.q: Where does this claw come from?
aliases: how to get huge gnoll claw
where to find huge gnoll claw
faq.answer: Hogger carries the claw. The elite gnoll wanders near the Riverpaw camps along the southwestern borders of Forest's Edge in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Dughan want a claw instead of the head?
faq.answer: Hogger is abnormally large for a gnoll, and his immense claws are distinct and instantly recognizable. One proves to the Stormwind Army that the notorious marauder has been slain.

faq.q: Can I get another claw if I lose it?
faq.answer: Yes. If you lose the claw before taking it to Marshal Dughan, you can hunt Hogger again in southwestern Elwynn Forest and claim a replacement.

angles.text: For the Alliance, claiming Hogger's claw rids the kingdom's heartland of its most infamous woodland terror. It proves your valor to Marshal Dughan and the beleaguered garrison at Goldshire.
As a hunter, securing the claw of a predator who routinely overpowered armed squads shows your skill at tracking and hunting beasts.
